_comment: Copy to run.local.json (gitignored) and edit. Paths here are read by the vm_*.py tools on the Colab VM, which receive no argv when invoked through 'colab exec -f'.
_data_source_note: 'url:<zip>' downloads the public dataset onto the VM. 'drive:/content/drive/MyDrive/<folder>' instead copies from a mounted Drive folder that already holds data/, weights/ and logs/ -- run 'colab drivemount' yourself first, it needs a TTY.
_persist_note: With a drive: source, symlink weights/ and logs/ into Drive so checkpoints survive the VM. With a url: source, poll and download them instead.
_experiment_note: Must differ from any released checkpoint name, or the final epoch overwrites it.
_eval_datapoints_note: null uses every trial, as the published run did. Small values (<32) can make a pooled-statistics column all-NaN and crash the evaluation.
_wandb_note: Upload the key as a file; never put it in this config, in argv, or in the repo.
